dataset_attribution: Haxby, Gobbini, Furey, Ishai, Schouten, and Pietrini (2001), Distributed and overlapping representations of faces and objects in ventral temporal cortex, Science 293:2425-2430. Original subject-2 BOLD and label bytes distributed by PyMVPA, without modification.

mask_provenance.source: NITRC Nilearn file 7868, release 3031, named Full brain mask for haxby
mask_provenance.limitation: The release notes identify this whole-brain mask but do not establish asset-specific licensing or its generation history. The dataset license and Nilearn software license are not substituted for a mask license. This local repair does not authorize public redistribution of the source bundle or image.

checksum_provenance: The subject-2 archive matched the independently retrieved, upstream-published MD5SUMS entry before extraction. Archive, member, registry and mask SHA256 values were then measured locally. Both extracted source files and the separately downloaded HTTPS mask exactly match the pre-existing read-only Nilearn cache. No publisher-supplied SHA256 or mask checksum is claimed.
transport_limitation: The originally attempted HTTPS data.pymvpa.org URLs failed hostname certificate verification before any body bytes. The publisher and pinned Nilearn fetcher document HTTP archive/checksum URLs; these were explicitly approved instead, without disabling TLS verification. A co-hosted MD5 registry over HTTP does not cryptographically authenticate the origin. These inputs are content-pinned and corroborated against the pre-existing cache, not independently origin-authenticated. Mask transport remains verified HTTPS.

acquisition_contract.failed_attempt_policy: Preserve partial payloads and the attempt ledger; do not silently retry or refresh content pins.

staging: Only these three unmodified source files and this manifest enter /app/data/objcat. No anatomical image, ROI masks, stimuli, other subject, generated matrix, fitted output or reference answer is staged. Runtime is offline.
